newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-So Minn hogs -Tuesday estimate 100,000 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-So Minn hogs -Tuesday estimate 100,000 - USDA.

text.p: Interior Iowa and southern Minnesota hog marketings Tusday were estimated at 100,000 head, compared with 116,000 a week ago and 110,000 a year ago, USDA said. Estimates include generally about 60 percent Carcass Base Hogs.
Barrows and gilts sold $1.00 per cwt higher than mid-session Monday. Trade was slow for good demand and light offerings. Weather conditions slowing movement in Northwest part of area.
Sows: Steady-3.00 higher, advance on weigts over 500 lbs. US 1-3 300-450 lbs. 42.00 -45.00 43.00 -45.00

Note: Prices quoted represent sales of hogs averaging 73-74 pct. carcass yields with mostly 1.00-1.25 inches of last rib backfat and 47-48 pct lean. Special considerations and grade premiums not reflected in base prices.
